name: Koldunic Sorcery (Way of Sorrow) — 1 Basic — The Frustrations of Nestrecha

system.description:
Named for the goddess of grief and failure, this power lets the koldun rob an opponent of his resolve. The koldun's stare saps the target's will to struggle; though he can still act, even fight, he does so half-heartedly, mastering none of his usual passion or determination. Like all powers of the Way of Sorrow, invoking it incorrectly turns the power back on its caster: on a botch, the koldun suffers the effect as if the victim had scored five successes.

System: The koldun's player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Koldunism (difficulty equal to the victim's Willpower). Making eye contact with the victim is required. For one turn per success, the target's player can't spend Willpower points to activate Disciplines or gain automatic successes.

MET System: Make eye contact with your subject and spend a Willpower Trait, then initiate a Social Challenge (Koldunism for retests) against the victim's Willpower. If you win, the victim can't spend Willpower Traits to activate any Disciplines until your next turn. On your next turn, you may reflexively spend a Social Trait and retest to sustain the power (no eye contact required to maintain it); it ends the moment you fail a challenge or choose not to maintain it.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
